start.text: Welcome, welcome. Company booking? Name? … Yes, here. Three nights only, sir-madam — the company has paid for three. After that, room is ₹1,800 a night, or you find a PG like everybody else.

no_extend.text: Sir-madam, in nine years nobody's company has extended. The room is on the right. Key is in the door.

key.text: Room is through the door on the right. Hot water six to nine only. Breakfast is idli, same every day. Welcome to Bengaluru.
